Class ClientController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.network.ClientController
public class ClientController extends Object
Client-side controller that handles the heartbeat to the server. It acts as a server stub for the view and redirects the requests to the server via a VirtualServer sending DTO. It also handles disconnections and sends heartbeat packages to the servers
